description: This file defines the IMembershipTable interface and related classes for the Orleans framework, detailing methods for managing and accessing silo membership data in a distributed system.

classes.name: TableVersion
classes.description: Represents the version of the membership table with monotonic version number and ETag for concurrency control.

classes.name: MembershipTableData
classes.description: Holds a snapshot of the membership entries and the associated table version.

classes.name: MembershipEntry
classes.description: Represents information about a silo, including status, address, and voting information.

methods.name: InitializeMembershipTable
methods.description: Initializes the membership table, preparing it for use.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Deletes all entries associated with a specific cluster ID.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes entries of silos that are considered defunct based on their last heartbeat timestamp.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads membership data for a specific silo atomically.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Reads the entire membership table atomically.

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.description: Atomically inserts a new membership entry and updates the table version.

methods.name: UpdateRow
methods.description: Atomically updates an existing membership entry and the table version.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the IAmAlive timestamp for a silo without changing other data.
